mainEntity.name: How long does LVP flooring installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of LVP flooring installation depends on the size of the area, the complexity of the room's layout, and the subfloor preparation required. For an average-sized room, installation can typically be completed within one to three days. Factors like existing flooring removal, extensive subfloor leveling, or intricate cuts around obstacles can extend this timeframe. Hometelligent Inc. prioritizes a thorough subfloor assessment to provide a realistic project timeline for your Alameda home.
